description: Withdraws a table's live pointer and detaches its refresh schedule: readers stop being served it and it stops refreshing. Nothing built is deleted, and promote_table later revives the same table. A live table must be demoted before archive_table will retire it. Example: {"table_id": "…", "expected_version": 4}. Pass expected_version from get_table so a table that moved in between is refused rather than withdrawn. Only call it when the person you are working for has asked for it. Returns {table_id, dataset_id, promotion_status, live_version_id, version, dashboard_url}. A table that was never promoted, or is already demoted, says so — read get_table rather than retrying.
name: demote_table
title: Stop serving a table
